verdict.rationale: SigNoz has some background automation: alerts on log patterns and signals run continuously and send notifications, and log pipelines transform data automatically before storage. Service accounts let external CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts call the API, but the MCP server and Agent Skills only let outside AI agents act interactively; nothing shows SigNoz running autonomous agents or user-defined automations itself. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automation workflows, autonomous AI agents running in the background, automated remediation actions, independent corroboration.
